title: Build settings page and settings view model
description:
Create the SettingsViewModel C++ class and SettingsPage QML component for configuring output directories, file naming patterns, format preferences (WAV/FLAC), auto-start/auto-stop behavior, pre-roll/post-roll durations, and export options.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/config/ or src/settings/ for any existing settings persistence layer (QSettings wrapper, JSON config, schema definitions) from earlier phases.
- qml/components/ for shared UI style conventions and component patterns.
- The plan's product requirements for settings scope: output directory, naming template, master format (WAV/FLAC), optional post-capture exports, auto-start/auto-stop thresholds, pre-roll/post-roll seconds.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
- src/ui/SettingsViewModel.hpp / .cpp: A QObject exposing Q_PROPERTYs for output directory, naming pattern, master format (WAV/FLAC), export enabled flag, export format, auto-start enabled, auto-start threshold, auto-stop enabled, auto-stop silence duration, pre-roll seconds, and post-roll seconds. Provide load/save Q_INVOKABLE methods that delegate to the persistence layer. Validate paths and emit error signals for invalid configurations.
- qml/pages/SettingsPage.qml: A scrollable form presenting all settings with appropriate controls (text fields, combo boxes, spin boxes, switches, folder picker). Group settings logically (Output, Capture Behavior, Export). Show validation feedback inline.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Build handoff: f.3 owns Phase F CMake registration, so this task must not edit CMakeLists.txt. Before editing, inspect the Phase-A QML resource/module convention in CMakeLists.txt so SettingsPage.qml follows its import/path convention. Its C++ source is compiled by the f.3 fan-in abracapture target build.
acceptance_criteria: src/ui/SettingsViewModel.hpp and src/ui/SettingsViewModel.cpp exist and define a QObject subclass with Q_PROPERTYs for at least outputDirectory, namingPattern, masterFormat, autoStartEnabled, autoStopEnabled, preRollSeconds, and postRollSeconds
SettingsViewModel provides Q_INVOKABLE load and save methods
qml/pages/SettingsPage.qml exists and binds to SettingsViewModel properties with appropriate input controls
SettingsViewModel does not perform audio capture, PipeWire calls, or compression
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file under src/pipewire/ or src/engine/
perform audio capture or PipeWire operations from the settings layer

allowed: choose validation approach for output directory paths
add local enum for master format options
choose settings grouping and layout within the page
forbidden: introduce a custom settings framework beyond QSettings
add audio capture or PipeWire dependencies

verification_commands.name: settings_viewmodel_cpp_syntax
command: c++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only $(pkg-config --cflags Qt6Core Qt6Qml Qt6Quick) -I src src/ui/SettingsViewModel.cpp
